title: direction.critiqued (v1)
description: CriticAgent has finished critiquing the frozen ProblemModel against the frozen ResearchSpec and frozen a CritiqueReport into the Research Store (see agents/critic_agent/data-contracts/critique_report.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the report is read from the Research Store by ref.

verdict.description: CriticAgent's overall verdict on the ProblemModel/ResearchSpec pairing, mirroring CritiqueReport.verdict.

critique_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen CritiqueReport object.
